title: More claimants submit their first claim within a week
body:
### Summary

Claimants submit their first claim within a week of signing up, so they get support sooner. It serves new claimants.

### Beneficiaries

claimants

### Metric

activation

### Baseline

0.31: activation (first claim submitted within 7 days) over the weekly cohorts of 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28, from `aayu measure` snapshot all-20261005T060000Z.sqlite (sha256 3f2a9c…e17b)

### Target

>= 0.40 by 2027-03-31
